integrity: Analytic proofs and a standard-library finite checker are included. Computational checks only support finite cases and numerical consistency; no independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotics take n to infinity first at fixed lambda and mu, then lambda to infinity; no uniform simultaneous growing-parameter theorem.
The one-parameter wheel reliability polynomial is pre-existing; no originality is asserted for that specialization.
The interior of the limiting reachability distribution is given constructively, not by a closed elementary density.
Unindexed earlier wheel-specific and marked-circle formulas could overlap.
title: Poisson-to-microscopic connectivity crossover for bond percolation on wheels
